Thus, a global section of $L^k$ on $X$ corresponds to a homogeneous polynomial $P(x,y,z)$ of degree $3k$ on $\mathbb{P}^2$ that restricts to zero on the fiber $X_t$ for all $t \in \mathbb{D}^*$.
Substituting the equation of the fiber, a section $s$ is given by a polynomial $P$ such that $P|_{xyz = t(x^3+y^3+z^3)} = 0$.

The space $H^0(X, L^k)$ is isomorphic to $H^0(\mathbb{P}^2, \mathcal{O}(3k)) / H^0(\mathbb{P}^2, \mathcal{O}(3k) \otimes \mathcal{I}_X)$.
Since $X$ is a hypersurface of degree 3, by the exact sequence
$0 \to \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(-3) \xrightarrow{\cdot F} \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2} \to \mathcal{O}_X \to 0$,
tensoring with $\mathcal{O}(3k)$ gives:
$0 \to \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(3k-3) \to \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2}(3k) \to \mathcal{O}_X(3k) \to 0$.
Taking cohomology, we get an exact sequence:
$0 \to H^0(\mathbb{P}^2, \mathcal{O}(3k-3)) \xrightarrow{\cdot F} H^0(\mathbb{P}^2, \mathcal{O}(3k)) \to H^0(X, L^k) \to H^1(\mathbb{P}^2, \mathcal{O}(3k-3))$.
Since $3k-3 \ge 0$, $H^1(\mathbb{P}^2, \mathcal{O}(3k-3)) = 0$.
Thus, $H^0(X, L^k) \cong H^0(\mathbb{P}^2, \mathcal{O}(3k)) / \text{Im}(\cdot F)$.
The dimension is $\binom{3k+2}{2} - \binom{3k-1}{2}$.
